positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid

positions.title: Tech Advisor
positions.description:
• Advised 400+ Computer Science students through career planning and teaching students to utilize their GitHub, LinkedIn, Resume, and Projects to their success.
• Supervised and planning tech events to improve students' knowledge and increase career outcomes 
• Created and maintained websites for our multiple college initiatives

company.name: City University of New York-Herbert H. Lehman College

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Deployed multiple full-stack web applications for public/private sector organizations across the country.
• Collaborated with engineering leaders at top tech companies to solve complex problems using Floreo methodologies.
• Led onboarding programs and training for nearly a dozen junior engineers entering tech companies across the country.

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description:
• Taught the fundamentals of object-oriented programming with Java
• Instructed students to create full-stack websites using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and MySQL
• Created lessons based on problem-solving where students access and manipulate data to build applications.

company.name: Continuing Education Programs at Hunter College

positions.title: Robotics Instructor
positions.description:
•Provide students with fun and educational concepts to guide and improve their imagination and creativity while learning a STEM-based curriculum. 
•Provide individualized instructions in a group setting in a friendly environment.
•Create customized lesson plans to improve student’s weakness or deficiencies in areas of science while utilizing Lego components. 
•Create a hands-on experimentation setting in order to develop the student’s skill for the following First Lego League challenge. 
•Teach students how to code utilizing Scratch to create video games.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant , NYC Tech Talent Pipeline
positions.description:
•  Engaged students to help them understand the various framework tools such as React, Redux, Express, PostgreSQL, and Nodejs  
•  Troubleshoot and solved issues students they have encounter when building their projects.
•  Graded students code base on functionality, readability, creativity, and ability to follow guidelines.

positions.title: Web Developer Intern
positions.description:
•   Assisted in development of correcting bugs and adding new features on large Ruby on Rails codebase.
•   Performed QA testing on Web and Android applications before the release of new updates. 
•   Engaged with tech-team in daily standups and meeting with suggestions on how to improve the company products.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Enhanced automated build and test infrastructure for conducting efficient performance studies with open-source measurement and analysis tools to ensure the tools run well on Intel’s next generation High-Performance Computing (HPC) platforms. 
•	Wrote LSF/bsub job scheduler scripts to launch performance study runs on a modest-sized Intel® Xeon Phi™ Knights Landing cluster.
•	Developing Python based parsers to extract performance data from benchmarks to integrate into the build and test infrastructure.
•	Engaged in weekly meetings with colleagues to discuss project progress and obtain feedback; delivered a presentation of a project to a well-attended forum.

positions.title: Python and Scratch Instructor
positions.description:
•	Instructed students how to program using Scratch JR, Scratch, and Python by having them create games and animations while refining their problem-solving skills and logical reasoning. 
•	Offered guidance to students building their own projects and help challenge them to push their logic and creativity.

positions.title: Python Instructor
positions.description:
•Educated students with the methods of Python as well as the development of educational curriculum around game design.
•Responsible for the development and implementation of curriculum for students
•Taught students how to code with Python through the interaction and utilization of PyGames 
•Demonstrated different coding concepts while creating a fun environment and lasting impression

positions.title: Software Tester Trainee
positions.description:
•	Worked in a team in a simulated work environment using software requirement documents to create a program to improve writing with Python
•	Developed test cases and tested sites using exploratory testing and black box testing alongside Doran Jones employees while reporting and documenting bugs using Jira  
•	Modified databases with MySQL as well as tested sites with automation tool Selenium

positions.title: College Assistant
positions.description:
•Worked in a fast-paced college environment to effectively monitor a comprehensive online database, quickly answer student queries and effectively manage and organize sensitive student records
•Processed and tracked tuition payments and correctly updated student records
•Provide basic troubleshooting and organized awards and paystubs in a comprehensive filing structure
•Resolved fee discrepancies, relayed tuition payment information and helped students utilize all online services on CUNYfirst

certifications.name: Certificate of completion: Introduction to agent skills

volunteerExperiences.description:
Serve as a peer mentor to S.T.E.M. majors by providing academic guidance and providing information about related occupations and career fields through various events and activities
•Promoted information sessions, career panels and multi-disciplinary events via social media 
•Organized community activities by appropriately scheduling activities and ensuring adequate student attendance to benefit the elderly, homeless and children such as city-wide walks and marathons
•Host fundraising activities such as bake sales and professional networking events
